questions.q: Which category of legacy data must be loaded first because transactional data depends on it?
options: Historical / summary data
Static / reference data
Open transactional balances
Defect logs
questions.explain: Static/reference data (chart of accounts values, suppliers, customers, bank accounts) must exist before transactional records that reference it can load.

questions.q: Why do most implementations avoid migrating full historical transaction detail?
options: It is expensive and usually unnecessary; the business needs correct balances, not to reprocess old transactions
Oracle Fusion cannot store historical data
Historical data is classified and cannot leave the legacy system
FBDI templates do not support historical data
questions.explain: Loading every historical transaction in detail is costly and generally unneeded — the business needs accurate open balances, not to re-process settled history.

options: A bank reconciliation matching rule
A defect severity classification
File-Based Data Import — the standard bulk-load spreadsheet mechanism
An Oracle Service Request type
questions.explain: FBDI (File-Based Data Import) is the standard structured spreadsheet template used for bulk-loading most conversion objects.

questions.q: What is the purpose of a mock conversion cycle?
options: To permanently load production data before go-live
To test Oracle Cloud Success Navigator
To replace the need for a configuration workbook
To run a practice data load well before cutover so problems are found on a non-critical timeline
questions.explain: Mock conversion cycles are practice loads run before the real cutover load, surfacing data problems early rather than during the actual cutover weekend.

questions.q: What did Brightfield's Data Migration Lead decide about the historical reconciliation archive?
options: Load it in full detail into Oracle Fusion via FBDI
Leave it in the legacy system's read-only reporting tool rather than loading it
Migrate it using ADFdi for ongoing maintenance
Delete it entirely since it is no longer needed
questions.explain: Brightfield scoped the historical reconciliation archive out of the Oracle Fusion load, keeping it in the legacy system's reporting tool for audit purposes only.
